findings.title: Committed generated artifacts drift without a gate
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: version.json is untracked + gitignored (.gitignore:76) and generated by apps/web/scripts/generate-version.js:17; SBOM/license artifacts stay untracked+gated; CI now runs scripts/openapi-audit.js and scripts/public-route-inventory.mjs --check (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:59,113-117). Residual: docs/openapi.yaml (16,797 lines) has no regenerate+diff gate - `pnpm --filter=api generate:openapi` (apps/api/package.json:14) is never run with `git diff --exit-code` in CI; the committed YAML can still drift from apps/api/src/openapi/spec.ts.

findings.title: Duplicate schema bootstrap SQL can be mistaken for the source of truth
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: docs/portal_platform_formal_handoff_bundle/supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.sql:16-21 still carries the 'HISTORICAL / GENERATED COPY - DO NOT EDIT (INV-P2-002)' header pointing at the live migration chain (5302026_...corrected.v3.sql).

findings.title: Large committed prompt/audit corpus inflates the application repository
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: prompts/PROVENANCE.md pins the corpus (623 files / manifest.json fileCount 623) and .github/workflows/validate.yml:134-148 runs `node scripts/verify-prompts.js verify` (hash + size-budget gate); disk count 625 = 623 pinned + manifest.json + PROVENANCE.md (excluded by scripts/verify-prompts.js:52-57).

findings.title: Stale, machine-specific repo path in the agent reference
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: AGENTS.md:3 names the canonical slug `github.com/MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech`; review.md mirror is kept in sync by scripts/sync-review-md.mjs --check.

findings.title: Committed build artifact apps/web/public/version.json is stale and unguarded
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: apps/web/public/version.json is no longer tracked (absent from the tree; .gitignore:76); the file is regenerated by apps/web/scripts/generate-version.js:17 before dev/build.

findings.title: Vestigial Vercel deploy configs remain after the DigitalOcean migration
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: `git ls-files | grep vercel` is empty - both root vercel.json and apps/web/vercel.json were removed after the DigitalOcean migration.

findings.title: Previous-run audit artifacts are amended in place without rebinding to the commit they now reflect
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: docs/audits/README.md adds the 'Bind every reconciliation' rule (RECONCILIATION_<date>.md records amendment date + develop commit/PR range + manifest binding) and both amended published runs carry RECONCILIATION_2026-10-12.md.

findings.title: Committed Supabase Studio scratch snippet duplicates a dev seed
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: supabase/snippets/ no longer exists (the committed 'Untitled query 314.sql' Studio scratch file duplicating supabase/seeds/00_local_auth_users.corrected.v2.sql was deleted).

findings.title: Service worker asset apps/web/public/sw.js is not registered anywhere
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: apps/web/public/sw.js is now registered - apps/web/components/ServiceWorkerRegistrar.tsx:29 calls navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', { scope: '/' }) (production-only) and next.config.mjs:35 serves the /sw.js headers.
